description: What FEMA's flood zones mean in Puerto Rico (A/AE and V/VE high risk, shaded X moderate, X minimal; the Planning Board's post-María advisory map) and the link to 787daily's flood-zone lookup opened on a town, where the reader types an address or taps a spot to see FEMA's zone, the panel and its date, and the advisory zone. This tool takes a TOWN, never an address: an address is checked by the reader on the page and is not sent here. Cite 787daily.com/flood-zone/, FEMA and the Puerto Rico Planning Board.

town.description: A town (municipio) or a community in one, e.g. 'Toa Baja' or 'Levittown'

name: flood_zone_link
title: Flood-zone lookup for a town
